_comment: TOOL contains public code, documentation and skill-level metrics.
DATA contains real runtime records. Keep it versioned in the PRIVATE companion.
Runtime DATA never resides in this public worktree, including ignored paths.
fleet-guards data_boundary.py enforces declared paths through the .githooks shims (git config fleet.guards).
_audited: Runtime records use tools/sie/runtime_data.py with exact companion data/ layout and path-only destination checks (no runtime visibility proof). New source-only Git worktrees live in the separate .worktrees/self-evolve namespace. Historical in-repository DATA paths remain blocked.
_data_home: SELF_EVOLVE_DATA_DIR selects exactly the PRIVATE companion data/ path; SELF_EVOLVE_CONFIG selects its repository root. All runtime records remain versioned there; source working copies are transient TOOL.
_calibration_defects: tools/sie/calibration_defects/ is TOOL: public code-defect specifications with find/replace patches and pytest oracles, not personal or lifelike records. The calibration runner requires these tracked specifications.
_fixture_generation: tools/make_fixtures.py provides synthetic artifacts used by scripts/setup_btarget_repo.py. Synthetic issuers and example.com sources are not real financial evidence.
_readme_diagrams: docs/diagrams/ DOT sources, rendered PNGs and render.py are TOOL documentation of the workflow; they contain no real runtime DATA.
